name: Webcam Preview (Linux)
summary: Open your USB / built-in webcam (V4L2) and show it in a preview window. Linux only.
description: Uses V4L2 to read frames from the kernel webcam driver, converts color space, and displays the video. The `device` variable is the V4L2 device node path — typically `/dev/video0`, but if you have multiple cameras or a virtual camera setup, list them with `v4l2-ctl --list-devices` and pick the right one.
